rows.en: This life of mine already died once!!
Take that, take that, take thaaat!!
Here I go, here I go, here I gooo!!
This was the real fight? That was nothing special!
This was the real fight? That was nothing special.
THIS was the real fight!? What a bunch of pushovers!!
This was the real fight!? Is this all the power you've got!?
This was the real fight? That was over fast...
This was the real fight? You're seriously underestimating us!!
This was the real fight? Are you serious!?
This was the real fight? That was over fast...
This was the real fight? That was over fast...
This was the real fight? That was over fast...
Ahahahahahaha!! The curtain hasn't come down yet, you know?
Revived kaijin!! Rise again for a third time!! Igiiiiii!!
Then the defeated revived kaijin came back to life, their wounds healing before everyone's eyes...
...and in an instant, they were restored to their original forms!
I'm back!! I can feel the power surging through me!!
How's that, Bee Woman! Zanjioh! We've been getting our power back bit by bit too!
How's that, Bee Woman! Zanjioh! We've been getting our power back bit by bit too!
Yeah! Ya weren't half as tough as ya talked!
Just so ya know, we're gettin' our power back too! This climax just keeps gettin' bigger!
How's that, Bee Woman! Zanjioh! We've been getting our power back bit by bit too!
How's that, Bee Woman? Zanjioh? We're regaining our power little by little too!
How's that, Bee Woman! Zanjioh! We're getting our power back too, y'know?
We're getting our power back too. We won't lose that easily.
We've been getting our power back too. There's no way we'll lose that easily.
We're regaining our power too. We won't be beaten that easily.
We're regaining our power too. We won't be beaten that easily.
Hmph!! You Lost Heroes are getting full of yourselves!!
In that case, Zanjioh! We'll finish them off with our own hands!!

notes.note: #0.22-#0.56 are an unlabelled battle montage (three rounds of party cries, ending in an enemy scream at #0.32, #0.44 and #0.56). Speakers not recovered; cries kept generic. Bat Man 'Kikikikiki!!' (#0.45) matches earlier slices.
Counting cries #0.28/#0.40/#0.52 (one/two/three) read as a kill count: 'That's one/two/three!!'. Speaker unknown.
Literal 'this is a life that died once'; implication (nothing to lose) left implicit. Speaker unknown (possibly a cyborg Rider or Heero).

#0.57-#0.66 are 10 party-leader variants mocking Bee Woman's earlier line (#0.3, 'that was a warm-up, the real fight starts now'); 'the real fight' chosen for the callback - check #0.3 in story_050 uses matching wording. Order matches #0.10-#0.19 and #0.79-#0.98: #0.59/#0.83-84 Momotaros, #0.62/#0.90 Zero-style, #0.95/#0.97 Setsuna/Heero.
Momotaros; singular 'yarou' addressed at the beaten group, rendered 'bunch of pushovers'.
Speaker not recovered; Bee Woman or Zanjioh (Zanjioh gives the revive order in #0.69).
Zanjioh (his 'Igiiii' cry); 'mitabi' = a third time. Line break before the cry removed.
#0.72/#0.76 Todogiller, #0.73 Spider Man, #0.74/#0.78 Bat Man (same cries as #0.7-#0.9 in story_050). Todogiller 'Brrrrrr' matches earlier English.
Speaker not recovered: one of the revived kaijin (likely Todogiller after #0.76); first person singular 'I' chosen.
#0.79-#0.98 are party-leader victory variants (pairs). Though they follow the revival in table order, they presumably play after the rematch is won. #0.88 (boku) given a slightly politer wording.
Momotaros 'masumasu climax da ze' rendered 'This climax just keeps gettin' bigger!'
Speaker not recovered (party reaction to DG Cells, answered by #0.103 in story_052). 'DG Cells' (Devil Gundam Cells) is not in the glossary.

report: 80/80 rows. Battle montage #0.22-#0.56 has no speakers; cries kept generic. Party-leader variants #0.57-#0.66, #0.79-#0.98 voiced by wording. #0.68, #0.77, #0.101 speakers inferred. 'DG Cells' not in glossary. 'the real fight' callback depends on story_050 #0.3 wording.
